StmtSimple.StatementText: BEGIN select mmh.MemberId, mmh.GroupId, mmh.BranchId, m.AdmissionDate, m.ClosingDate INTO #MemberInfo from [program].[MemberMoveHistory] mmh with (nolock) INNER JOIN program.Member m with (nolock) on m.id = mmh.MemberId where @endDate BETWEEN mmh.StartDate AND ISNULL(mmh.EndDate, 20991231000000) AND mmh.BranchId = @BranchId

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT * INTO #LoanAccountSchedule FROM ( SELECT *FROM #LoanSchedule ls UNION ALL SELECT la.MemberId ,[LoanAccountId] ,0 ,[DisburseDate] ,0 ,0 ,la.PrincipalAmount ,DisburseAmount - la.PrincipalAmount [OutstandingInterestAmount] ,DisburseAmount [OutstandingTotalAmount] ,0 [OverdueTotalAmount] ,@EndDate ,@BranchId FROM #LoanAccount la LEFT JOIN #LoanSchedule ls on la.Id = ls.[LoanAccountId] where ls.[LoanAccountId] IS NULL AND [DisburseDate] <= @EndDate AND (Status = 1 OR ClosingDate > @EndDate) ) AS T1

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(bt.Credit), 0) as BadDebtRealized, bt.BranchId INTO #BadDebt FROM #MemberInfo mi inner join program.BadDebtTransaction bt with(nolock) on bt.MemberId = mi.MemberId AND bt.BranchId in (SELECT branchId from #MemberBranch) AND bt.TransactionTypeId = 9 AND bt.TransactionDate = @EndDate AND bt.PaymentMethodId in (1,2) GROUP BY bt.BranchId

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT st.BranchId, ROUND(SUM(Credit),0) as [Total Savings Realized], ROUND(SUM(Debit),0) as [Total Savings Withdrawal/ Return/ Adjust] INTO #Savings FROM #MemberInfo mi INNER JOIN program.SavingsTransaction st with(nolock) on st.MemberId = mi.MemberId WHERE st.TransactionDate = @EndDate AND st.PaymentMethodId<>3 AND st.BranchId in (SELECT branchId from #MemberBranch) GROUP BY st.BranchId

StmtSimple.StatementText: SELECT ISNULL([Admission Member],0) AS [Admission Member], ISNULL([Return Member],0) AS [Return Member], T1.BranchId AS AdmissionBranch, T2.BranchId AS ReturnBranch INTO #AdmissionandReturn FROM ( SELECT COUNT(Distinct MemberId) AS [Admission Member], mi.BranchId FROM #MemberInfo mi WHERE AdmissionDate = @EndDate AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT MemberId FROM [program].[TransferReceiveMember] with (nolock) WHERE [TransferReceiveMember].[TransferredMemberId] = MemberId AND [ReceivingBranchId] in (SELECT branchId from #MemberBranch)) group by BranchId ) AS T1 FULL JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(Distinct MemberId)AS [Return Member], mi.BranchId FROM #MemberInfo mi WHERE ClosingDate = @EndDate AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT MemberId FROM [program].[TransferReceiveMember] with (nolock) WHERE [TransferReceiveMember].[TransferredMemberId] = MemberId AND [TransferredFromBranchId] in (SELECT branchId from #MemberBranch)) group by BranchId ) AS T2 ON 1 = 1
